approved_protocol.rewrite_population: recorded rewrite calls, including goal separately; distinguish proposal and effective query
rewrite_axes: semantic fidelity to current question and supplied history
approved_protocol.answer_to_rewrite_unit: one later rewrite, grouped by supplied prior-answer history; actual binding sources traced separately; never pair current answer with earlier same-step rewrite
final_outcome_tables: literal node/event conditional proportions as supplements
approved_protocol.review: offline stage review hidden final outputs/scores; recheck incorrect and fixed-seed 10 percent correct
approved_protocol.old_labels: strict matching plus scope/evidence/axis compatibility verification, candidates only
approved_protocol.missing: record absent data as missing, never as a semantic label; unresolved factual decisions go to user
approved_protocol.child_correctness: current child question factual correctness; correct regardless of retrieved support; reasonable abstention when evidence truly insufficient is correct
approved_protocol.goal_preanswer: review separately from ordinary child answers
approved_protocol.final_evidence: inspect actual final-visible context, separately from child factual correctness
approved_protocol.root_cause: evidence-based nonexclusive failure locations and propagation/containment, not counterfactual causal effects
approved_protocol.partial_list_answers: factually correct listed items count correct; completeness not required; subtype retained
approved_protocol.web_scope: retrieved material/native dataset first; web only if local materials cannot determine correctness
